mapper.select: SELECT hmr.bp_id, hmr.bp_type ,hbt.description type_description,hbc.description category_description,hmr.enabled_flag enabled_flag FROM hls_bp_master_role hmr, hls_bp_category hbc, hls_bp_type hbt WHERE hmr.bp_category = hbc.bp_category and hmr.bp_type = hbt.bp_type and hmr.bp_id = #{bpId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT hbt.description type_description,hbc.description category_description,hbc.enabled_flag enabled_flag FROM hls_bp_type hbt, hls_bp_category hbc WHERE hbt.bp_category = hbc.bp_category AND hbt.bp_type = #{bpType}
SELECT bt.description FROM hls_bp_master_role mr, hls_bp_type bt WHERE mr.bp_type = bt.bp_type and mr.bp_id = #{bpId ,jdbcType=BIGINT } and mr.enabled_flag = 'Y'

select bc.bp_category,bc.description category_description ,bt.bp_type ,bt.description type_description from hls_bp_category bc left join hls_bp_type bt on bc.bp_category= bt.bp_category WHERE 1=1
AND bc.bp_category like concat('%',concat(#{bpCategory},'%'))
AND bt.bp_type like concat('%',concat(#{bpType},'%'))
select bp_type,description as type_description from hls_bp_type
SELECT bt.bp_category FROM hls_bp_type bt WHERE bt.bp_type =#{bpType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT mr.bp_type FROM hls_bp_master_role mr WHERE mr.bp_id = #{bpId ,jdbcType=BIGINT } AND mr.enabled_flag = 'Y'
